name: DCC Energy plc
summary: DCC Energy plc engages in the sales, marketing, and distribution of carbon energy solutions in the Republic of Ireland, the United Kingdom, France, the United States, and internationally. The company operates in two segments, DCC Energy and DCC Technology.
